economy.summary: Sponsors Senate Bill 19, which would raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage to $15 an hour with annual cost-of-living adjustments, set the tipped wage at 70 percent of the minimum, and let municipalities set higher local minimums; she says all six neighboring states have higher minimum wages and that the increase would benefit over 1.3 million Pennsylvanians.
economy.short: Sponsors bill raising minimum wage to $15 with inflation adjustments.

taxes.summary: Voted for and praised the 2025-26 state budget as responsible and balanced, saying it supports affordability, education, and public safety without raising taxes, provides tax relief for nearly one million residents, and creates a new Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit for working families.
taxes.short: Backed 2025-26 budget: no tax increases, new working-families credit.

abortion.summary: After the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade in 2022, co-sponsored legislation to codify abortion protections into Pennsylvania law, saying the legislature needed to act to ensure women retain the right to safe abortions without government interference in decisions between a woman and her healthcare team.
abortion.short: Co-sponsored bill codifying abortion protections into Pennsylvania law.

education.summary: Says the 2025-26 state budget she supported funds public schools fairly and constitutionally and strengthens the childcare workforce, including a $450 minimum payment to childcare workers; she also highlighted expanded enrollment and funding for The Bridgeway School, Pennsylvania's only recovery high school.
education.short: Supports budget funding public schools fairly; strengthens childcare workforce.

healthcare.summary: Calls investment in home care and direct care workers a moral and practical necessity, noting that more than half the residents of her district rely on Medicaid, and says direct care workers provide independence and dignity for seniors and people with disabilities; she supports legislative action to strengthen the profession.
healthcare.short: Supports strengthening home care workforce; cites district's Medicaid reliance.

guns.summary: Announced legislation to prohibit the possession, sale, manufacture, and transfer of machine gun conversion devices known as auto sears or Glock switches, saying fully automatic machine guns do not belong on the streets and citing their use in Philadelphia mass shootings.
guns.short: Proposes banning machine gun conversion devices in Pennsylvania.
